privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: This Privacy Policy explains how Future Path collects, uses, and protects personal data in compliance with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and the UAE Child Digital Safety Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 26 of 2025).
privacy.s2li1: Basic user information: name, date of birth, gender, school, grade, and country.
privacy.s2li2: Assessment data: responses to career, learning, and values questionnaires.
privacy.s2li3: Technical data needed to run the service securely: your IP address and browser, used to rate-limit requests and detect abuse. We use no third-party analytics or advertising trackers, and we do not profile you across other websites.
privacy.s2li4: Evidence of consent: when a school administrator records guardian consent, we store their name, email, the wording they agreed to, and the IP address and browser they used, as proof of that attestation.
privacy.s2note: We do not collect medical or biometric data, and we never see or store card numbers — card payments are handled entirely by our payment processor. We do keep a record of a school's own purchases (the amount, date and payment reference) against the buying account.
privacy.s3li1: To generate personalized career and learning guidance.
privacy.s3li2: To enhance user experience and system performance.
privacy.s3li3: To provide anonymized insights for institutional reporting.
privacy.s4Body: An unclaimed guest assessment is deleted automatically 72 hours after it is completed, and an unfinished one shortly after the session that started it expires. Data in a registered account is kept while the account is open. Signed-in users can download their data or delete their account at any time from their profile, and a school can remove a student it enrolled. For anything else, contact us at support@futurepath.ae and we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s5Body: Future Path is designed for students aged 13 to 18. Students do not register themselves. A parent or legal guardian registers on the student's behalf and gives consent, or the student's school gives consent for the students it enrols.
privacy.s6Body: All data transmissions are encrypted using SSL/TLS protocols and stored in secure, access-controlled environments.
privacy.s7Body: Future Path does not sell, trade, or rent personal data. Limited data may be shared with authorized educational institutions strictly for career guidance purposes.
privacy.s8Contact: Contact: Signed-in users can download their own data or delete their account at any time from their profile — no need to contact anyone for that. For any other question about your data, or to exercise your rights under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021, email support@futurepath.ae. We will respond within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Future Path, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, you should not use the platform.
terms.s2Body: Students must be between 13 and 18 years old. A parent or legal guardian, or the student's school, must give consent before a student takes an assessment.
terms.s3Body: Users agree to use the platform only for its intended educational purpose — career guidance for students. Schools and parents may purchase licences; reselling access, or using the platform to provide a competing service, is not permitted.
terms.s4Body: All platform content—including assessments, algorithms, user interfaces, and design elements—is the intellectual property of Future Path and protected by copyright law. Reproduction, redistribution, or reverse engineering is prohibited.
terms.s5Body: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and any activity under their account.
terms.s6Body: Future Path reserves the right to suspend or terminate access for violations of these terms or misuse of the system.
terms.s7Body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.s1Body: Future Path is an educational tool designed for career exploration and self-awareness. It does not provide psychological, clinical, or diagnostic services.
disclaimer.s2Body: While Future Path strives for accuracy, results are based on user input and established research models. The platform and its partners are not liable for any academic, career, or personal decisions made based on assessment outcomes.
disclaimer.s3Body: Schools and educators using Future Path remain responsible for interpretation, counseling, and decision-making support.
disclaimer.s4Body: Our website may include links to third-party resources. Future Path is not responsible for their content or data practices.
disclaimer.s5Body: Our assessments are based on validated research models and proprietary methodologies. Results should be interpreted as guidance, not definitive career predictions.
